title: How WhatsApp Product Requests Work at Cosmic
summary: Search the catalogue, build a basket, and send it to Cosmic Pharmacy in one message. Here is what happens after you press send.
author: Cosmic Pharmacy team (demo draft)
body: Cosmic Pharmacy's website lets you search products, add what you need to a basket, and send the whole request to the pharmacy on WhatsApp. It is a request, not an online checkout. Nothing is charged and nothing is reserved until the pharmacy confirms it with you.
## What happens after you send

A member of the Cosmic team reads your request, checks availability, confirms final prices, and asks any questions a pharmacist needs answered before dispensing. If an item needs a prescription or pharmacist review, they will let you know exactly what is required.
## Pickup, delivery and shipping

When your request is confirmed you can choose pickup at the pharmacy, delivery in Belize City, or shipping to the districts and the main islands. The team confirms charges and timing in the same conversation.
## Why we work this way
Medicine is not a click-and-forget purchase. Keeping a real pharmacist in every request means you get the right product, honest pricing, and a person to ask when something is unclear.

title: Five Questions Worth Asking Your Pharmacist
summary: A short guide to getting more from every pharmacy visit: what to ask, what to bring, and why the conversation matters.
author: Cosmic Pharmacy team (demo draft)
body: Your pharmacist is one of the most accessible health professionals you have. A few good questions can make every product you take home safer and more useful.
## 1. How should I take this?
Timing, food, and daily routine can all matter. Ask before you leave the counter.
## 2. Does this fit with what I already take?
Bring a list of your current medicines and supplements so the pharmacist can check for combinations that need attention.
## 3. What should I expect?
Ask what is normal, what is not, and when to come back or see a doctor.
## 4. How do I store it?
Heat and humidity are real considerations in Belize, and some products need extra care at home.
## 5. Is there a sensible alternative?
Sometimes a different format, size or brand fits your needs or budget better. A pharmacist can tell you when that is a fair swap and when it is not.
This article is general information, not medical advice. For anything concerning a symptom, a condition, pregnancy, or a prescription, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

title: How to Read a Supplement Label
summary: Serving size, per-serving amounts, and the difference between a claim and an ingredient: the basics of reading any supplement label.
author: Cosmic Pharmacy team (demo draft)
body: Supplement shelves are full of confident packaging. The label on the back is where the useful information lives.
## Start with the serving size
Every amount on the panel is per serving, and a serving might be one tablet or three. Check before comparing two products.
## Look at the ingredient list, not the front of the box
The front is marketing; the panel is the contract. The ingredient list tells you what is actually inside and in what form.
## Marketing claims are not medical claims
Words like “supports” and “helps maintain” are general wellness language, not treatment promises. No supplement replaces diagnosis or prescribed treatment.
## When in doubt, bring it to the counter
If you take other medicines, are pregnant, or manage a chronic condition, ask the pharmacist before adding anything new. That conversation is free and it is what we are here for.
This article is general information, not medical advice.
